Q: Dymos: Change initial conditions while using a restart file A:

Try using the restart option in a first call with dm.run_problem, but don't run the driver or use simulate, just "run_model" to make sure values are propagated.

Then set your desired state values and call run_problem again.

Q: Vite Library Mode with CSS Imports A:

Late reply, but perhaps it helps someone.

I see that your vite.config.ts you are using [vite-plugin-lib-inject-css](https://github.com/emosheeep/vite-plugin-lib-inject-css). It is responsible to add the import statement import './main.css'; to the dist/main.js file. Therefore, first check if the built main.js has the import statement. If it is there, it means the library configuration is fine.

In the package.json file, the sideEffects should probably be set to "sideEffects": ["**/*.css"] instead of true.

However, the error message in your message looks like Remix is trying to import the css file as a Javascript file and fails as a result. Therefore, you might want to check also the Remix project settings.

Q: Custom SpinLock implementation A:

An answer was posted here.

Summary:

  • the lambdas access data only via data.0 which is why they capture not the whole SyncWrapper
  • possible workaround: add following line inside lambdas: let data = &data;

Q: Kotlin Multiplatform Library with compose UI elements used in androidMain A:

Looking at your code, I was able to reproduce your error in an existing project of mine by using:

implementation(platform(libs.compose.bom)) // ❌ Now deprecated

instead of the now recommended:

implementation(project.dependencies.platform(libs.compose.bom)) // ✅ Use this

So my best guess to resolve this issue would be to change to the latter.
In the latest version of IntelliJ IDEA (which I recommend for KMP development), it marks platform as deprecated with the message:

'fun platform(notation: Any): Dependency' is deprecated. Scheduled for removal in Kotlin 2.1. Check KT-58759.
